purpose: Frozen component-input and causal-predictor sensitivity audit. No controller, horizon, map, or seed is selected from these outcomes.

protocol.shared_platform: 300 kW engine, 150 kW motor/battery bus, literature-shaped virtual map, 600 s stochastic agricultural cycle
protocol.terminal_rule: abs(SOC_T - SOC_0) <= 1e-4 with common terminal-energy governor
protocol.frozen_controllers: ECMS lambda=2.0; terminal-set scenario MPC H=8 with five scenarios
protocol.causality: public nominal task phase and present demand/SOC only; no future realized seed sample
